_note: The five periods of the oeuvre, in one place. The period titles used to exist only inside a generator that rendered the curators page; the exhibition and book pages also point at them, so the wording lives here and every reader of it agrees. Ranges are inclusive; the last period is open-ended.

_usage.curators page: Each language's curators.html carries one section per period, with the id below so it can be linked to. Edit the page, then keep this file in step.
_usage.exhibition and book pages: Each record names its period and links to /<lang>/curators.html#<id>.
_usage.audit: tools/audit_record_depth.py checks that every record names a period that exists here and links to an anchor that exists on the curators page.
